history.summary: A tiny 452 sqft freehold 1BR (shoebox) in D14 at $1,903 psf, 870m from Kaki Bukit MRT. The bias-adjusted appreciation is weak (1.33%) and the project carries new-launch bias (TOP 2023), with a long 870m MRT walk — a fairly priced shoebox with no growth thesis.
history.rating_rationale: has_new_launch_bias=true means the headline rate was discounted to a thin 1.33%/yr (resale-only 2.30%) — both below baseline, so this recently-completed (2023) project has not demonstrated real appreciation yet. The 452 sqft shoebox is the smallest unit in the batch (narrow resale appeal, weak per-sqft livability), and Kaki Bukit MRT at 870m is a 10-min walk, not true MRT-doorstep. Asking $1,903 psf is below the $2,061 median, and freehold D14 tenure gives downside support — enough to avoid Avoid, but with no appreciation evidence and a shoebox format, there is no buy case.
red_flags: new_launch_bias true + bias-adjusted 1.33%/yr — no proven appreciation, recent 2023 TOP
452 sqft shoebox — smallest, most niche unit, weakest livability and resale breadth
Kaki Bukit MRT 870m / 10-min walk — not genuine MRT proximity
$1,903 psf is high in absolute PSF for a fringe-D14 shoebox
